rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the gradual restoration of health.

example.english: After the operation, recuperation takes time, so you can't rush it.
example.traditional: 手術之後要慢慢康復，唔可以心急。
example.jyutping: sau2 seot6 zi1 hau6 jiu3 maan6 maan2 hong1 fuk6 m4 ho2 ji5 sam1 gap1

rows.note: Use this for the act or instance of getting an item, money, or possession back, not for recovery of health.

example.english: I finally got the deposit back, which was a welcome recuperation.
example.traditional: 我終於攞返筆按金，真係好開心。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 lo2 faan2 bat1 on3 gam1 zan1 hai6 hou2 hoi1 sam1
